title: Bible Web App Module Settings
description: Controls which modules are visible and how they are grouped in the UI. Place in the data directory as settings.json. If this file is absent, no modules are visible (fail-safe).

about.description: Custom 'About' text displayed in the app settings panel.

active.description: Whether this module is visible to users.

section.description: A named group of modules displayed together in the UI.

title.description: Section heading shown in the module selector.

helpText.description: Optional help text displayed below the section heading.

modules.description: Ordered list of module abbreviations in this section.

moduleTypeConfig.description: Configuration for one module type (bibles, commentaries, or dictionaries).

modules.description: Map of module abbreviation to its configuration. Only modules listed here with active: true are visible.

sections.description: Ordered sections for grouping modules in the UI. Modules not in any section appear under 'Other'.
